A sketch of the phase space with nullclines and the corresponding direction field of tangents to the solutions of a system of differential equations is shown above (the tangents are not drawn to scale). Which of the following could represent the trajectory starting at the point marked on the graph?
worked_solution:
Let's sketch the trajectory.

- We start at the given point, going along with the flow (upward and slightly to the right), and crossing the x-nullcline where the tangents are vertical.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14068149/assets/6aa850c4b0fb7cde00bed079de3cde5c2fcfa22c5c2bdae40b43ddb099f27cc7.png)

- After that, the trajectory goes to the right and slightly upward to infinity.
